notes: The page at rest for a guest: the title and the card that stands in for a plan the page cannot read without a session. `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the card, because it is the region both clients draw identically: the guest mark, the two sentences and the gradient action. Widths of the two sentences are left out deliberately - they are the run of the words, not a decision. Colours are left out too - they are what the raster proves. The member's Ready state needs the fixture account's own plan and is not part of this contract yet.

motion.notes: The plan card is still. Loading is a two-block pulse skeleton; the only other motion is the page route transition and the browser focus ring.

entries.moves: two skeleton blocks pulse until the plan arrives
entries.same: the same two-block pulse; reduced motion shows the settled card without the pulse

entries.gesture: keyboard focus moves through the page
entries.moves: the browser focus ring appears on the focused control
entries.same: the same focus order and an equivalent focus indication; nothing travels
